semantic.justification: Original OTypeCollection and comphelper container2 owners are ported as OWriteStream prerequisites. Type collections preserve original1..12 arities/default tail/order/duplicates and actual Sequence/Type assignment/copy/COW/destruction. Container2 preserves the single raw acquired interface/vector union, iterator copy-on-change/ownership, pointer-first/root equality, duplicates, null early return, reverse snapshot callbacks, detach-before-dispose and source exception handling. Multi-type storage uses real Type keys and snapshots borrowed container pointers while retaining empty containers. Pinned IfTest testCreateDispose/testEnumerate and all four TestInterfaceContainer2::test1 scopes are translated with genuine components/owners; critical reentrancy/error scenarios are added. CALC-497/WRITER428 and CALC-498/WRITER429 retain original null and debug-diagnostic contracts. Synchronous calls erase native mutex parameters/scopes without a surrogate; native locking/union ABI/allocations and full OWriteStream/parent storage/model/filter/Worker/UI remain unverified or unfinished. Browser persistence policies are unchanged.
